about: Revenge roster records that are NOT a wrestler of their own (2026-11-14, revfix): Revenge itself draws another man for them, so the handler makes no folder for them. Each with what Revenge shows -- its own Costume Change screen with his code poked in and Default pressed (rig\cc_all.py; scratch\agents\revfix\rig\cap\cc_<code>.png, sheet work\cc_managers.png) and its own match (scratch\agents\revbody\rig\cap\rv_<code>_*.png). None of them can be picked in Revenge. Delete an entry to import him anyway.

0x806.name: Ted Debisas
0x806.shows: Vincent -- the nWo's bald security man in the nWo T-shirt and jeans (costume 50, the same as Vincent's and James Bandenderg's); the handler's old capture of this record even came out Scott Hall's (his nWo look, part for part).

0x807.name: James Bandenderg
0x807.shows: Vincent -- the same man as 0x808, costume 50, part for part the same look.

0x903.name: Jackreen
0x903.shows: Sting -- his 'Crow' look of Revenge (black coat, his face paint, the baseball bat): Revenge's frame-4 attire 6, mask 1. Revenge has no Jacqueline model.

0x904.name: Sister Sherri
0x904.shows: Sting -- the same 'Crow' look (frame-4 attire 6, mask 2); her record also uses Sting's own moveset file (0x1F7). Revenge has no Sherri model.

0x905.name: Woman
0x905.shows: a bearded man in a white T-shirt (costume 32 of frame 2, a man's body and head) -- not Woman; Revenge has no model of her.
